faq.q: What is an AI ad image generator?
faq.a: It turns one product photo into a square image for a feed ad. You add the headline and the price afterward in your ad editor.

faq.q: How do I create an image ad from a photo?
faq.a: Upload the product photo, pick a scene with room for type, and download the square file. Then build the ad in the platform's editor.

faq.q: Which placements is the file for?
faq.a: The download is square, which fits many feed placements. Check the crop and safe area in each ad tool. It is not auto-sized for every story or banner.

faq.q: Can the image include my headline?
faq.a: Leave space for it, then type the exact line yourself. Generated lettering can be wrong, so prices and brand marks stay in your editor.

faq.q: Can I make several versions from one photo?
faq.a: Yes. Generate different scenes from the same product photo and compare them before you choose the ad. Each one costs 24 credits.
Stores and marketers who already have a product photo and need another square scene without a new shoot.

faq.q: Can I run the image in a live ad?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark and are licensed for commercial use. Confirm the crop in your ad tool before launch.

faq.q: Do I have to label the image as AI?
faq.a: Rules differ by platform and region. Follow the disclosure your ad account shows for that campaign. For a more casual still, see [UGC style product photos](page:tpl-ugc).

items.t: Make two scenes before spending on the ad
items.d: Upload the catalog photo, try a desk and a sidewalk, and keep the version that still shows the product clearly.

items.t: Use a worn view only when the garment matches
items.d: If the piece should be worn, use an AI-generated adult and set that view next to the flat photo. The person in the frame is not a customer.

items.t: Change the offer without a new shoot
